svg.title: Your devices, watched 24/7: the host captures the picture and sound once, and several services read that same copy, each catching a different problem
svg.text: MONITOR 24/7 · WHAT A HOST DOES ALL DAY
The video is captured once. Many watchers read it.
Each one catches a different problem, even when no test runs.
The Stream service records the picture and the sound, day and night
One copy, made once. Every watcher below reads this same copy.
Side by side, each one looks for a different problem
None of them presses a key: the device is only watched.
A problem that lasts becomes an incident
Even at 3 a.m., with no test running
Closed when the picture is back
The same for a frozen picture or lost sound.
A short black between two channels is not an incident: it is timed as a zap.
A profile is a set of services
Each device turns on only the services it needs
The Stream always runs. Gold is on, grey is off: the rest stays idle.
Switch off what nobody reads, and the host gets its CPU back.
Each watcher catches a different problem.
